name: Town/Village of Harrison
gaps: No maximum floor area / FAR for residences in the residence table (only minimum habitable floor area); max_floor_area null
No impervious/total coverage limit in the residence table; max_impervious_coverage null
Minimum lot depth not set; frontage expressed only as 75% of required lot width (min 50 ft, § 235-33), left null
County attributes list 26 ft height for R-1/3, R-75, R-50; the code table (Supp 120, Mar 2019, amended through L.L. 1-2018) says 30 ft — code value used
Business districts (CBD, MFR, NB, PB, GC, SB-*) not covered; MF added because one-family dwellings are permitted there

wetlands.summary: Ch. 149 Freshwater Wetlands: Planning Board permit for regulated activities in a wetland or its 100 ft adjacent area. Zoning § 235-31: buildings and structures set back 50 ft from streams and water bodies (except R-75, B, MF and business districts, where the Town Engineer/Board decide).

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 199: permit to disturb slopes of 15%+ covering at least 500 sf (one dimension >= 10 ft); classes 15-25% steep, 25-35% very steep, 35%+ excessively steep.

trees.summary: Ch. 220: Building Department tree removal permit to remove or substantially alter any tree of 4 in. or more trunk diameter at breast height on private property, unless covered by an approved subdivision or building permit.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 130: stormwater/erosion control approval for land disturbance; SWPPP for disturbance of 5,000 sf or more; activities under 500 sf exempt but must follow erosion BMPs.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment use in the residence Table of Use Regulations; accessory buildings may not be used for residential purposes (§ 235-18B(1)).

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings incl. garages: not in required front or side yards; allowed in rear yard at the table setback (5-50 ft) with 15 ft max height and 10 ft max wall height in the required rear yard; 75 ft from the street (R-2.5 to R-1/3, GA) or 60 ft (R-75, R-50, B); 10 ft from the main building (§ 235-18).
general.pools: Only where accessory buildings are allowed; at least 10 ft from side/rear lines in B, R-75, R-50 (20 ft elsewhere) and 60 ft from any street in B, R-75, R-50 (75 ft elsewhere); 4 ft fence; lot at least 50 x 100 ft (§ 235-28).
general.notes: Harrison is a coterminous Town/Village with one zoning code (Ch. 235). Driveway slope max 15% (§ 235-18B(5)).

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage: main and accessory buildings

accessory.notes: Max 15 ft high; not in required front or side yards; may sit in the rear yard at the table's rear-line setback; exterior wall in a required rear yard max 10 ft high; 10 ft from main building (§ 235-18A(2),(4), B(2),(4)); at least 75 ft from the street line (§ 235-18B(2))

R-2.5.notes: Front-lot-line width must be >= 75% of the required lot width, min 50 ft (§ 235-33). Floodplain lots: height measured from base flood elevation (note 4).

B.source: § 235-9B, Residence Districts Table of Dimensional Regulations (Attachment 2); § 235-18B
B.notes: 2,500 sf lot area per dwelling unit; two-family permitted. Coverage counts all area under a roof to the outermost wall/structural component (note 1). § 235-33.3: height measured from 2 ft above the lowest floor to roof midpoint, lowest level not a story, no flat roofs; lowest floor max 4 ft above lowest grade at rear line. Floodplain lots: up to 33 ft (note 3). Front-lot-line width must be >= 75% of the required lot width, min 50 ft (§ 235-33).
